sources.author: Smortthings
patch_list: LocalThings Owner PSK in device settings
Shows a device's OwnerPSK (for Home Assistant LocalThings) on its Edit screen, extracted locally via the app's own key store. Tested on HW-Q950A / SmartThings 1.8.52.23.
